description: Query Obyte mainnet and testnet: balances, units, autonomous agents, AA state, dry runs, tokens.
name: io.github.Taump/obyte-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Default Obyte network used when a tool call omits the network argument. Both networks stay available.
environmentVariables.name: OBYTE_NETWORK

environmentVariables.description: Custom mainnet hub URL. Must be https, except http localhost is allowed for development.
environmentVariables.name: OBYTE_MAINNET_HUB_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Custom testnet hub URL. Must be https, except http localhost is allowed for development.
environmentVariables.name: OBYTE_TESTNET_HUB_ADDRESS

environmentVariables.description: Testnet token registry AA address for symbol and decimals lookups.
environmentVariables.name: OBYTE_TESTNET_TOKEN_REGISTRY_ADDRESS

packageArguments.description: Default Obyte network used when a tool call omits the network argument. Both networks stay available regardless.
packageArguments.name: --network

packageArguments.description: Custom mainnet hub URL. Must be https, except http localhost is allowed for development.
packageArguments.name: --mainnet-hub

packageArguments.description: Custom testnet hub URL. Must be https, except http localhost is allowed for development.
packageArguments.name: --testnet-hub

packageArguments.description: Testnet token registry AA address. Testnet symbol lookups need an explicit registry when used.
packageArguments.name: --testnet-token-registry

title: Obyte MCP
